Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: privacy-policy
Version: 2.0.0

The skill bundle is a legitimate privacy policy generator that uses a bash script (scripts/privacy.sh) to output text templates for GDPR, CCPA, and standard privacy policies. It contains no network activity, unauthorized file system access, or malicious instructions, and its behavior aligns perfectly with its stated purpose.

llm.summary: The skill is a local privacy-policy template generator and the files/commands provided align with that purpose; there are no requests for credentials, network calls, or unusual install steps in the provided content.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (privacy policy generator, GDPR/CCPA) matches the included SKILL.md and the bash script which generates privacy-policy text templates based on provided options (company, email, website, DPO, type). No unrelated capabilities (cloud access, secrets, system administration) are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md lists simple generator commands (generate, gdpr, ccpa, app, website, audit, help). The runtime script parses CLI args and prints templated policy text; it does not instruct reading unrelated files, scanning system state, or sending data externally in the visible portion. The SKILL.md and script remain within the stated scope.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is present; the skill is instruction-only with an included bash script. This is low-risk compared to downloading/executing remote code. The included script is self-contained and uses standard shell features.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The script uses only date and provided CLI arguments; requested environment/credential access is proportionate (none).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. It does not claim to modify agent/system configuration or require persistent privileges. There is no evidence it would enable permanent presence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a local template generator and is internally consistent with its description. Before installing or running: (1) review the full scripts/privacy.sh file yourself (the snippet is benign but the file was truncated in the manifest) to confirm there are no network calls, file writes, or unexpected commands; (2) remember the output is a template and not legal advice—have a qualified lawyer review any final policy for your jurisdiction; (3) run the script with harmless dummy arguments or in a sandbox to validate behavior (use --help to see available options). If you need remote or automated publishing of policies, expect additional permissions or credentials will be required and review those carefully.
